summary: rfp_decision_log accepts Amanda's RFP / Bid Workflow audit steps (associate, classify, analyze, request_queued) and RFP-level rows with no proposal_id. No data changes.

preflight.name: rfp_decision_log exists
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'rfp_decision_log'

preflight.name: proposal_id is still NOT NULL
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'rfp_decision_log' AND column_name = 'proposal_id' AND is_nullable = 'NO'

expected_changes: rfp_decision_log.action CHECK gains associate, classify, analyze, request_queued.

verify.name: proposal_id is nullable
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'rfp_decision_log' AND column_name = 'proposal_id' AND is_nullable = 'YES'

verify.name: action check allows the workflow steps
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'rfp_decision_log_action_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%request_queued%'
